Onboarding.Welcome.Heading: Welcome to CloudSync
Onboarding.Welcome.Intro: CloudSync keeps your cloud files and this computer in step, and always shows you what it is doing and whether your data is safe.
Onboarding.Welcome.NothingYet: Nothing is synchronised until you have chosen what to sync and confirmed a summary.
Onboarding.Welcome.Steps: Setup takes four short steps: connect your provider, choose folders, review, then start.
Onboarding.Welcome.Later: You can skip setup now and do it later. You can also change your choices at any time in Settings.
Onboarding.Connect.Heading: Connect your provider
Onboarding.Connect.Intro: Sign in to OneDrive in your browser. Signing in does not copy any files.
Onboarding.Connect.Retry: Sign-in did not finish. Check the message above, then press Connect OneDrive to try again.
Onboarding.Scopes.Heading: Choose what to sync
Onboarding.Scopes.Intro: Tick the folders to synchronise and choose where they will be stored on this computer. Nothing is copied yet.
Onboarding.Scopes.Requirement: Tick at least one folder and choose a local folder to continue.
Onboarding.Review.Heading: Review before you start
Onboarding.Review.Intro: This is what CloudSync will do once you confirm. Until then, nothing is synchronised.
Onboarding.Review.WhatHappensNext: What happens next: when you confirm, CloudSync saves this setup and starts the first synchronisation. You can follow it on the next screen and on the Dashboard.
Onboarding.Sync.Heading: Initial synchronisation
Onboarding.Sync.Intro: Your setup is saved. Live progress is not available yet, so the values below are placeholders.
